economic_meaning.detail: capacity returns unallocated in analyzed runtime. Open requires unallocated >= A+T, subtracts A+T and adds only T to escrowed. Treasury reserve is additional to the full advance, not a deduction from its proceeds and not the entire nominal 15% uplift. Raw Desk USDG balance is neither capacity nor maximum immediately lendable advance.

evidence.locator: Literal aw, Unicode character offsets[1019855,1034368); consumer binding to advance-desk; ABI entry[12]

permissions.detail: Unpaid position requires maturity; any caller then. Paid early close requires owner; ordinary full repay finalizes immediately.

economic_meaning.detail: For unpaid matured close, after attempted staking catch-up, M=floor(currentIndex*oraclePrice/10^21), U=owed-paid and W=wsLocked. taken=min(ceil(U*10^18/M),W); covered=min(U,floor(taken*M/10^18)); paid+=covered. Shortfall is emitted if still unpaid, but position closes, wsLocked becomes zero and all original lock leaves lockedTotal. Taken wsNET remains in Desk inventory; remainder returns to owner. No USDG collection or AMM sale occurs on this path; covered is this close's valuation increment, not cumulative paid.

permissions.detail: Permissionless and not halted; actual failed transfer can revert.

economic_meaning.detail: At finalization, T=floor(originalAdvance*500/10000), O=original owed and P=final paid including collateral coverage. treasuryDue=min(T,floor(T*P/O)); escrowed-=T; unallocated+=T-treasuryDue. Cash comes from reserve funded at open, not a sale of taken collateral. A reverted Treasury token call or canonical false defers due to treasuryOwed; malformed/empty successful returndata can revert the whole close. payTreasury is permissionless while halted but strict: failed transfer reverts, preserving debt on real EVM rollback. Other strict transfers, including owner collateral return, can also revert finalization.
